Description: Teensy 4.1 microcontroller board (PJRC) with pin headers
Octal bus transceiver, Teensy to slot (3.3 V in, 5 V out)
Octal bus transceiver, slot to Teensy (5 V tolerant in, 3.3 V out)
MSX cartridge slot, 50 pins (2 x 25), 2.54 mm pitch
DC-DC converter 5 V to +12 V / -12 V (Murata NMA0512SC)
USB type B socket (FCI/Berg PN61729-S), 5 V power input
Ferrite bead in the 5 V input, axial, 10 mm pitch
Schottky diode, slot supply to Teensy VIN
LED 3 mm green with built-in resistor for 5 V (LED101 Teensy VIN, LED102 +5 V)
Electrolytic capacitor 470 uF 16 V, radial, 3.5 mm pitch, 8 mm diameter
Resistor network 8 x 10 kOhm, common pin, SIL9
Pin header 2 x 2, 2.54 mm, with jumper (open for normal use)
